messages.content: 誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
在爵士樂界，評選「最佳」歌手往往取決於個人品味、歷史影響力以及技術表現。以下列出五位被廣泛認為對爵士歌唱藝術有深遠貢獻且在多數評論家與粉絲心目中佔據頂尖地位的歌手（按字母順序排列）：

| 歌手 | 代表作品 / 標誌性風格 | 為何被視為頂尖 |
|------|---------------------|---------------|
| **Billie Holiday** | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” | 她的情感真摯、即興靈活度高，並以獨特的音色改寫了爵士歌唱語法。 |
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | “Summertime”, “Dream a Little Dream of Me” | 被譽為“天籟之聲”，其完美的音準、無絕句即興技巧和清晰的發音成就了她的傳奇。 |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | “Misty”, “Lullaby of Birdland” | 她擁有四聲部音域、柔韻十足的低音與高音，能夠將複雜旋律轉化為流暢抒情。 |
| **Nina Simone** | “Feeling Good”, “I Put a Spell on You” | 她把爵士、藍調、古典與民謠融合，並以強烈的社會意識與戲劇張力著稱。 |
| **Cassandra Wilson** | “All the Things You Are”, “The Last Time I Saw Paris” | 她以低沉、富有質感的嗓音重新詮釋經典曲目，並在現代爵士領域持續創新。 |

> **備註**：如果你想了解更多關於某一類型（如小號、薩克斯風等）的頂尖演奏者，可以使用 `search_music_instrument_players` 函式。例如：  
> ```json  
> { "instrument": "saxophone", "genre": "Jazz", "top": 5 }  
> ```

希望這份列表能幫助你更深入探索爵士歌唱的巔峰！
message.reasoning: The user asks "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which translates to "Who is the best jazz singer?" They want a list of top singers. We can use the function search_music_instrument_players? But that's for instrument players, not singers. There's no function for singers. So we need to answer manually. Provide a list of top jazz singers. Use knowledge cutoff up to 2024. Provide maybe 5 names. Also mention criteria. Let's respond.
